_readme: Bill of materials shown on bom.html. Edit freely and send a pull request. status: needed | quoted | ordered | received. unitCost is an estimate in USD (null = unknown).

items.item: DMX512 pixel tube, HTD-T40-20IC-5050RGB style (size TBD: 0.5 / 1 / 1.5 m)
items.notes: 36 used + 4 spares

items.item: RGBWUV DMX head for the hub globes (8 ch, about 15 W)
items.notes: One per hub. Channel layout and watts are placeholders until the head is chosen
Snap-on around the tip ball joint; 32 × 12 mm holes, tube ports left clear
Snap-on around the middle-hub ball joint; 32 × 12 mm holes, tube ports left clear

items.item: Short XLR patch lead for each globe head
items.notes: Patches the head into the tube chain at its hub
One per universe (up to 8) plus spares
Links the tip where one run ends to the middle hub where the next starts. Lengths are on the Wiring page (3 to 5 needed, depending on tube size)
One per tie point (winch); drives the universes that start at its two hubs. The 1.5 m tubes need 8 outputs, so use 4-output nodes there

items.item: 5-pin XLR feed cable, node to start hub
items.notes: One per universe; short, as the node sits at the tie point

items.item: Ethernet cable, network to each node
items.notes: Runs with the winch line; length depends on the room
Joins the PC and the 3 nodes
Existing PC
One per tie point, beside its winch. The Wiring page shows each supply's load
About 6 m per winch line, from each supply down to its two hubs
Hub-to-hub injection where a chain is long
One per hub feed (2 per tie point)
Design TBD — 3D print or machined
Carries the load; needs a rated lifting point

items.item: Motorised winch (rated for the sculpture weight with safety factor)
items.notes: Ideally with limit switches and a brake
Winch lines and bridle legs
One per winch
3 per winch
Independent of the winch lines
